completed_outcomes.outcome: origin/main merged into epic-568/441-binding-store at bcfba265; the single map/INDEX.md conflict resolved by regenerating the map (python -m scripts.code_map build --root .), never hand-edited.
completed_outcomes.evidence: git status showed UU map/INDEX.md as the only unmerged entry; regeneration left no conflict markers; git commit bcfba265; advance g1-merge re-ran tests/test_code_map.py and it passed.

completed_outcomes.outcome: OUTCOME 1 -- nothing breaks. #441's spawn tests (test_spawn_binding_transaction_red_green, test_spawn_binding_sessionstart_claim_mixed_writer_race in tests/test_spine_rail.py) build their spines via put_checklist()/write_spine(), which write raw JSON with no `origin` key. origin_worktree_refusal() returns None unconditionally when spine.get('origin') is not a dict, before it ever reaches the cwd/git-toplevel check, so the guard never engages for these tests regardless of the pytest tempdir.
completed_outcomes.evidence: grep '"origin"' tests/test_spine_rail.py tests/test_gauge_writer.py returned zero hits. Direct repro: subprocessed scripts/checklist_engine.py claim from a bare (non-git) tempdir cwd twice -- with an origin-stamped spine naming a different worktree (REFUSED: 'claim refused: this spine belongs to the worktree ..., but no git worktree toplevel could be resolved'), and with a spine matching put_checklist's shape with no origin field (claimed successfully, exit 0). pytest tests/test_spine_rail.py -k spawn_binding: 2 passed. tests/test_gauge_writer.py has no spawn/multiprocessing pattern and no origin field, so it is not implicated.

completed_outcomes.outcome: Clean-env (env -u SPINE_FILE -u SPINE_SESSION -u SPINE_PARENT), cache-cleaned, foreground full pytest -q run: 3028 passed, 6 skipped, 1136 subtests passed, 0 failed. Branch pushed (7733d452..bcfba265). gh pr view 589 --json mergeable now reports MERGEABLE (was CONFLICTING).
